No explicit block rule found for the internet-facing zone talking to itself (e.g. untrust -> untrust, any application, drop). PAN-OS allows intrazone traffic by default unless a rule overrides it, unlike interzone traffic which is denied by default. Use 'drop', not 'deny': deny falls back to the matched application's own default deny behavior, which can still send a TCP reset or ICMP unreachable back, revealing that something is listening there. Drop silently discards the packet instead, giving an internet scanner nothing to work with.
